verdict.rationale: Stagehand's docs say it caches act(), observe() and extract() results to cut LLM costs and speed up automations. The v3 docs describe built-in auto-caching that turns agent-discovered workflows into deterministic scripts running 10-100x faster. Recorded selectors with an optional selfHeal re-inference further show actions are replayed rather than re-prompted. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of cache replay, and documented detail on cache keys, invalidation and local (non-server-side) caching in v4.
